analysis_type: post-hoc exploratory physical economy replay audit

source_config.capacity_semantics: FIFO experiences per agent, including episodic records; 0 means unlimited
source_config.fairness: same local input schema and cap, original architecture lookup rules; structured exact-key versus retrieval top-4 is disclosed
source_config.eligibility: scheduled decisions only when own inventory is below next delivery need; policy can change future opportunity count
source_config.freeze: development0:9; heldout1000:1029; thresholds1,2,3 predeclared; no heldout selection

source_hash_exceptions.exception: post-run plot-label layout; not imported by study execution
HTTP adapter: later optional intervention-verification endpoint

conservation_checks: cash flow, agent inventory, market stock, inspection fees, and settlement quantities passed in every replay
independent_unit: paired seed; four family-world rates averaged within seed
ci_method: 95% approximate t intervals using existing stats helper; no multiplicity adjustment

definitions.cash: actual final nominal cash and change from initial cash, per agent; not a complete welfare measure
definitions.ordered_quantity: three units per actual purchase event, reconstructed from the fixed _purchase rule
definitions.filled_quantity: actual purchase-event quantity after stock and affordability constraints
definitions.zero_fill_order_rate: zero-quantity purchase events / purchase events; zero for no orders
definitions.paid_inspections: inspection_booked events, including terminal requests without a later inspection
definitions.commitment_miss_rate: commitments with status missed / all commitments; partial delivery counts missed
definitions.delivery_fill_rate: actually delivered units / required commitment units
definitions.categorical_regret: existing reserve-available=2, defer-disrupted=6, verify=1.5 loss; not replaced or retuned

limitations: same held-out worlds reused after observing categorical results; exploratory
nominal cash excludes the value of remaining grain and nonfinancial objectives
policy changes later decision eligibility; purchase and inspection counts may differ
worlds with no purchase orders contribute zero to order-rate means
no policy, scenario, cost, source artifact, or original result changed
elapsed audit time is not a performance benchmark
